nav.label: Appearance
nav.description: Colours, fonts, images, login page and texts

appearance.previewHint: Changes are previewed on the whole site for you only, until you save them.

theme.presetsHint: A starting point for both light and dark themes. Picking one clears the colours set by hand.
theme.colorsHint: Adjust each colour of the light and dark themes. Members still choose light, dark or system.
theme.radiusHint: Roundness of buttons, fields and cards.

typography.heading: Headings
typography.headingHint: Font of page and section titles.
typography.monoHint: Font of sizes, ratios, hashes and code.

images.loginImageHint: Shown by the Split and Background login designs.
images.homeBannerHint: Wide picture at the top of the member dashboard.
images.formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 8 MB max. Saved right away.

login.layoutHint: Used by the sign-in and sign-up pages.

layouts.centeredHint: Logo and form in the middle of the page.
layouts.splitHint: Picture on the left, form on the right.
layouts.backgroundHint: Full-page picture behind a translucent card.

login.imageHint: Without a picture, this design uses the accent colour. Add one in the Images tab.

texts.hint: Replace any text of the interface, language by language. Leave a field empty to keep the shipped text.
texts.search: Search a key or a text…
texts.placeholders: Keep the words between braces of the original text: they are replaced by values such as names or numbers. Plural forms are separated by a vertical bar surrounded by spaces.
